title: The Ass Carrying the Image
summary: An ass carrying a sacred wooden statue through the city saw the crowds bowing down before him. Conceited, he brayed proudly and stopped moving....
full_text:
An ass carrying a sacred wooden statue through the city saw the crowds bowing down before him. Conceited, he brayed proudly and stopped moving.

His driver struck him with a staff: "Move on, fool! They are bowing to the statue, not to the ass who carries it!"
moral: Do not assume that honors paid to the sacred burden belong to the beast that carries it.
